snippet.title: SPACE BAR | Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
SPACE BAR is a minimalist psychological horror experience.

Hold the Space Bar and see where it takes you.

No jumpscares.
No monsters.
No complicated mechanics.

Just you... and a single key.

Sometimes the simplest ideas are the ones that stay with you the longest.

🎮 Play SPACE BAR on itch.io
Price: Free (donate if you want)
https://zeroeclipsekitsune.itch.io/space-bar

📺 Played by GermansnakeGaming
https://youtu.be/9mwurQ4h-F4?si=uHu27UokTNYAQ0UY

(More creator playthroughs will be added here over time.)


also in the recording I have zoomed in so my OBS isn't too distracting, since rn the game looks better in windowed mode since it has a scaling issue where it doesn't adapt to full screen mode
